integrity_notes: A self-contained analytic proof supplies the global quantifiers; finite exact checks are corroboration only. Source dates use first arXiv submission, not journal publication.
scientific_limitations: The novel conclusion is the complete integer multiplicity spectrum for multiplicities two and higher; the single-illumination case is previously known.
The argument applies to the complex bidisc and equivalent open half-square covers of the flat two-torus; no extension to higher products or different side lengths is asserted.
The novelty comparison is best-knowledge, not an exhaustive historical priority certificate.
title: Exact multiple illumination of the complex bidisc
